sentence: If I had known about the party, I would come.
ruleVi: Câu điều kiện loại 3: mệnh đề kết quả dùng would have + V3.

sentence: If she has studied harder, she would have passed the exam.
ruleVi: Câu điều kiện loại 3: mệnh đề if dùng quá khứ hoàn thành had + V3.

sentence: We would have caught the train if we had leave earlier.
ruleVi: Sau 'had' trong mệnh đề if loại 3 dùng quá khứ phân từ (V3).

sentence: If Minh hadn't helped me, I would have fail the test.
ruleVi: Mệnh đề kết quả loại 3: would have + V3.

sentence: If it hadn't rained, we will have gone to the beach.
ruleVi: Điều không có thật trong quá khứ dùng would have + V3, không dùng will.

sentence: They wouldn't have got lost if they had took a map.
ruleVi: Sau 'had' dùng quá khứ phân từ: take → taken.

sentence: If you had told me earlier, I could had helped you.
ruleVi: Sau modal could dùng 'have + V3' để nói khả năng đã không xảy ra.

sentence: If Lan hadn't missed the bus, she wouldn't had been late.
ruleVi: Mệnh đề kết quả loại 3: wouldn't have + V3.

sentence: He would have won the race if he didn't fall.
ruleVi: Mệnh đề if của câu loại 3 dùng quá khứ hoàn thành: hadn't + V3.

sentence: If I saw you yesterday, I would have said hello.
ruleVi: Điều đã không xảy ra trong quá khứ: If + had + V3, would have + V3.
